messages:
Priya: heads up — noticed some users kept access after a recent group rename + provisioner backlog. not a full outage but KMS grants didn't get cleaned up.
Mateo: hmm are you seeing deprovision logs? which provisioner run timeframe?
Priya: root at 2026-03-19T12:05:11Z — group rename job ran at 11:58, provisioner heartbeat lagged ~7m due to db lock. the SCIM delete events exist, but our audit log shows missing scim.external_id for the recreated members
Sam: can you paste the relevant logs? curious whether it's the tombstone path or the upsert flow
Priya: pasted below — truncated
```
2026-03-19T11:59:03Z INFO provisioner: received group_rename id=grp_1024 -> name="eng-ml-v2"
2026-03-19T12:05:11Z WARN provisioner: retrying update due to db_lock timeout
2026-03-19T12:06:05Z INFO scim-client: delete member id=usr_8790 external_id=null
2026-03-19T12:06:09Z INFO scim-client: upsert member id=usr_8790 external_id="" name="elena"
2026-03-19T12:06:10Z INFO kms-manager: grant created principal=usr_8790:local
```
Sam: aha — external_id blank vs null. our KMS mapping uses external_id to correlate and remove stale grants during rename. empty string slipped through.
Elena: I saw the grant linger in the audit table earlier today. worried this could escalate to cross-tenant access on linked service accounts (low probability but we should be safe).
Mateo: immediate mitigations: 1) run a targeted reconcile that treats "" as missing external_id and forces full cleanup 2) patch provisioner to normalize empty->null on delete events 3) add a fast check in kms-manager to avoid creating grants when external_id is blank
Priya: can we scope the reconcile to the rename window only? avoids noisy churn
Sam: yes — query events where event_time between 2026-03-19T11:58:00Z and 2026-03-19T12:10:00Z and member_id in (affected group). I'll run it with dry-run first.
infra-bot: deploy job 3421 queued by @sam — tag=hotfix/normalize-empty-externalid
DevOps (audit-bot): FYI — KMS grant creation events recorded: grant_id=g-9f3a, principal=usr_8790:local, created_by=provisioner-service, reason="upsert"
Sam: ran dry-run reconcile -> found 13 grants created for members with empty external_id. Posting remediation plan in thread.
Priya: plan looks good. add an alert rule to detect provisioner heartbeat > 30s and group_rename in progress (to avoid recurrence)
Elena: also request an audit log backfill: correlate grant_ids -> scim events so we can produce timeline for compliance.
Mateo: assigning owners: Sam -> run reconcile + roll; Priya -> compliance packet + backfill query; Elena -> KMS guardrail change; I'll own postmortem and follow-up test cases.
Priya: ETA for hotfix deploy?
Sam: 30m for rollout to staging, 2h to prod with canary.
Mateo: low-severity incident, but treat as P1 for access-control fixes. notify CISO and compliance because of KMS artifact retention.
Priya: noted. I'll open an incident doc and tag legal + ciso.
Elena: small note for after-action: add unit tests for external_id normalization and add a property in schema forbidding empty string.
Sam: thanks — will include in PR. :thumbsup:
DevOps (audit-bot): incident created INC-2026-0319-07, notifications sent to ciso@redwood
Priya: closing loop — reconcile started. will post results and granting/revocation counts when done.
